limitations: The campaign records a bounded, selected public-market cohort, not the full venue.
Displayed depth and public quote survival do not identify hypothetical fills.
Shared feed intervals and connected market families are dependent observations.
A full SQLite integrity scan is optional; the complete event hash chain is not reverified.
The external campaign status file is intentionally excluded from the SQL snapshot.

reason_interpretations.book_issue:advertised_top_pending: The recorded advertised top was not reconciled by the frozen follow-up quality checks.
reason_interpretations.book_issue:timestamp_regression and futu: The recorded event-time ordering was inconsistent; these are evidence-quality labels and do not alone prove an implementation defect.
reason_interpretations.cross_outcome_observation_skew: The two outcome observations exceeded the frozen synchronization window.
reason_interpretations.future_book_receipt: A book had an event receipt later than the decision evaluation time.
reason_interpretations.future_observation_unavailable: No qualifying synchronized future observation was found in the recorded source for this horizon; this does not establish that the venue had no quote.
reason_interpretations.independent_book_divergence: The independent outcome books disagreed under the frozen consistency check.
reason_interpretations.invalid_at_decision: The frozen policy marks each horizon censored because the initial observation failed its recorded quality gate; inspect the initial_quality_regime breakdown for the reason.
reason_interpretations.market_retired_or_unobserved and market_: The market was absent from the reconstructed cohort at follow-up.
reason_interpretations.missing_durable_decision_commit_proof: The worker lacked durable commit timing proof for the decision.
reason_interpretations.missing_outcome_snapshot: The source lacked one required outcome snapshot at the follow-up check.
reason_interpretations.recorded_gap: and book_issue:gap:: The source or reconstructed book recorded a continuity/resynchronization gap.
reason_interpretations.reported_expiry_reached: The market's reported lifecycle end was reached.
reason_interpretations.source_followup_availability_timeout: The bounded follow-up source did not produce an available observation before its recorded timeout.
reason_interpretations.source_prefix_ended: The available source prefix ended before a qualifying follow-up.
reason_interpretations.source_revision_changed: The source producer or reconstruction identity changed from the frozen allowlist.
reason_interpretations.source_timing_uncertainty and shadow_clo: Recorded receiver/clock timing uncertainty blocked a synchronized label.
reason_interpretations.stale_book: A future book was available but failed the frozen freshness rule.
reason_interpretations.tick_regime_changed: The effective tick-size regime differed from the initial decision.
reason_interpretations.unlabeled_causes: The source does not identify unsupported contract semantics, legitimate outcome unknowability, or a confirmed implementation defect as separate causes unless a specific recorded reason says so.
reason_interpretations.unsupported_pair_semantics and invalid_c: The contract relationship failed the frozen payoff/identity checks.
reason_interpretations.unverified_market_metadata: Required market or fee metadata was not verified by the frozen checks.

regime_definitions.censoring_regime: A descriptive grouping of the recorded follow-up censor reason; it does not infer causes absent from the source event.
regime_definitions.initial_quality_regime: valid_initial_observation or invalid_initial:<frozen decision quality reason>
regime_definitions.pending_followup: No outcome row exists for the selected decision and frozen horizon in this SQLite read snapshot.

scientific_interpretation.decision: Keep no-trade. Treat missing future rows as unresolved absence/coverage, retain stale and gap quality gates, and defer strategy training because all observed five-second targets lack an initial discrepancy and execution remains counterfactual.
